answer.book: Antonii Fayi, Emblemata et epigrammata miscellanea (Geneva, Chouët, 1610): front matter (title page, dedications to Thomas Wharton, address to the reader, list of authors), then a main body of about 1,290 emblems and epigrams in running sections under the emblem heading, two Sylvae, and an alphabetical index. This answer is incomplete: it gives entries for the front matter, the opening Deo/Lectori pages, the two Sylvae and the index start, but does not enumerate the emblem series, which the sheet holds in full and which runs to several hundred divisions.
